normalization: Fixed physical scales; closed channels zeroed before scaling
supervision: Simulator internal fields projected at window START; all learning models share labels
projection_definition:
Bounded least squares in the volume-weighted D strain norm.

The minimum field error is a privileged diagnostic, not a prediction-error
lower bound. A rank-deficient basis need not identify unique coefficients.
